changes: Create manual current-account entries, their audit records and recovery keys atomically.
Require an actor-scoped key on the new idempotent route and recover matching requests without a second ledger entry.
Keep existing callers compatible, validate exact cents and reject blank descriptions and document types.
Keep commission spending in the dealer's own order payment flow; manual current-account posting cannot simulate commission use.
Apply CURRENT view/create permissions, freeze unresolved submissions and expose original-request recovery outside the form.
Separate successful writes from failed balance refreshes, support read retries and ignore stale account responses.
Prevent draft amounts and descriptions from carrying to another party; keep exports numeric and tied to the displayed period.
limitations: Recovery keys remain in the current screen session. After a full reload, inspect history before entering another transaction.
manual_checks_pending: Browser layout and separate director/view-only-manager checks after deployment.
